Name: q1
Title: Winter Is Coming
Description: Lady Maera of Wolf Ridge needs stores for winter: 10 pine logs and 5 cooked river trout.

Name: q2
Title: Blood of the Dragon
Description: Dragonkeeper Rhaella on Dragonmont will bond you to a red drake — if you bring 5 smoked salmon to win its trust. (Requires: Winter Is Coming)

Name: q3
Title: Fire and Blood
Description: Take wing and raze the five towers of the Ember Keep on southern Dragonmont with dragonfire. Beware their ballistae. (Requires: Blood of the Dragon)

Name: q4
Title: Thrones of the Elements
Description: Four Throne Guardians haunt the corners of the realm — the Gilded Sentinel in the southwest barrows, the Venom Sentinel in the deep south, the Flame Sentinel in the Ember Keep, and the Frost Sentinel beyond the Frostwall. Each guards a Dragon Aspect that can recolor your drake, and wields the finest gear of its combat class — bow, staff, katana and armor.

Name: q5
Title: The Chained Wraith
Description: A fifth terror is bound to the Drowned Bastion, a ruined islet deep in the southern sea where no bridge reaches — only a dragon's wings. Slay the level 90 Chained Wraith to claim the Wraith Dragon Aspect and, if fortune favors you, its Runed Chain-Glaive.
